🎨 Backend Sheet Appearance

Every new observation row is auto-styled (borders, wrap, alignment) and each calendar day gets its own alternating row color so adjacent days are easy to tell apart at a glance. Use this to re-apply that styling retroactively across all existing month sheets, or after manually editing rows in Sheets.

🛡️ ICMS Sync Key
This key authenticates kavach_sync.py when it POSTs synced ICMS cases from the KAVACH portal into this dashboard. Paste it into the script's config when setting it up. Regenerating invalidates the old key — update the script's config afterward.
🚉 HBL NMS Sync Key
This key authenticates hbl_nms_sync.ps1 when it POSTs live loco entries from the HBL NMS portal into this dashboard's Quick Register Queue. Paste it into the script's config when setting it up. Regenerating invalidates the old key — update the script's config afterward.
🩹 Data Integrity — Duplicate SR Numbers
Two rows can end up sharing the same SR No if observations were submitted close together in time (this is now prevented going forward — see below) — a duplicate SR breaks verify/reject/flag/label lookups for whichever row those actions accidentally hit. Scan finds them; fixing keeps the earlier-created row's number untouched and gives every later duplicate a fresh, currently-unused number. No other column is ever touched, and rows are never deleted or reordered.
🩹 Data Integrity — Rows Out of Date Order
New observations are now inserted at their correct date position in the sheet, not always at the bottom — so back-filling an earlier date after later ones are already entered lands it next to its own date's other rows instead of after them. That's prevented going forward; this scans for rows that got misplaced by it before the fix. Fixing stable-sorts each sheet by Date — same-day rows keep their original relative order, every column moves together as one row, and SR numbers travel with their row unchanged.
